title: Minor overhaul to GUI documentation
body:
An attempt to give GUI-specific documentation some love:

* The GUI docs moved out of the list of modules for easier access. Since people will typically not interact with the GUI the same way as with the other modules, this feels more logical.
* The 'GUI basics' page is reorganized and partially rephrased to progress in a more logical way and should now (in my opinion) serve better as a user's guide.
* All missing menu items were added to the doc pages of the 'Edit', 'View', and 'Tools' menus. A short explanation and keyboard shortcuts were added where applicable.
* Removed outdated references and instructions wherever I spotted them

Closes: ase/ase#899
author: lempelto

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Inline suggestion to change the section title/header formatting in the RST file — a concrete code change.

I think I preferred having the tutorials directly after the install, because it provides an easier point of entry for beginners. I would suggest:

```suggestion:-4+0

    gettingstarted/gettingstarted
    cmdline
    ase/gui/gui
    ase/ase
```
